title: Tiger cub eating a snack
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='72' rx='26' ry='20' fill='#ff9d1c'/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='78' rx='16' ry='12' fill='#ffe6a8'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='40' r='22' fill='#ff9d1c'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='32' cy='24' r='8' fill='#ff9d1c'/>
  <circle cx='32' cy='24' r='4' fill='#ffb6c1'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='24' r='8' fill='#ff9d1c'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='24' r='4' fill='#ffb6c1'/>
  <!-- cheek stripes -->
  <rect x='28' y='38' width='10' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#5a2e00'/>
  <rect x='28' y='44' width='10' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#5a2e00'/>
  <rect x='62' y='38' width='10' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#5a2e00'/>
  <rect x='62' y='44' width='10' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#5a2e00'/>
  <!-- forehead stripes -->
  <rect x='46' y='19' width='3' height='8' rx='1.5' fill='#5a2e00'/>
  <rect x='51' y='19' width='3' height='8' rx='1.5' fill='#5a2e00'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='41' cy='37' r='4.5' fill='#2a1a00'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='37' r='4.5' fill='#2a1a00'/>
  <circle cx='42.5' cy='35.5' r='1.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='60.5' cy='35.5' r='1.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <path d='M47 45 Q50 42 53 45 Q50 49 47 45 Z' fill='#ff6b8a'/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d='M50 49 Q46 54 43 51' fill='none' stroke='#5a2e00' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M50 49 Q54 54 57 51' fill='none' stroke='#5a2e00' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- front paws holding snack -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='60' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#ff9d1c'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='60' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#ff9d1c'/>
  <!-- snack (a little fish) -->
  <g>
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='9' ry='5' fill='#6ec6ff'/>
    <path d='M59 58 L66 53 L66 63 Z' fill='#4aa8e8'/>
    <circle cx='45' cy='56.5' r='1.2' fill='#1a3a5a'/>
  </g>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M74 82 Q86 78 84 66 Q83 60 78 60' fill='none' stroke='#ff9d1c' stroke-width='5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M84 66 Q83 60 78 60' fill='none' stroke='#5a2e00' stroke-width='5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- body stripes -->
  <rect x='30' y='70' width='3' height='10' rx='1.5' fill='#5a2e00'/>
  <rect x='67' y='70' width='3' height='10' rx='1.5' fill='#5a2e00'/>
</svg>
